name: @foreverworks/mcp-porkbun
description: MCP server for Porkbun domains, DNS and hosting: Porkbun's official tools, served with per-client tokens, an audit line per call, purchases marked for the client to confirm, and files uploaded by path

mcp.title: Porkbun
mcp.tagline: Register domains and manage DNS, hosting and mail at Porkbun, with every purchase confirmed first.

PORKBUN_API_KEY_FILE.title: API key file
PORKBUN_API_KEY_FILE.description: Path of a file holding your Porkbun API key (pk1_...).

PORKBUN_SECRET_API_KEY_FILE.title: Secret API key file
PORKBUN_SECRET_API_KEY_FILE.description: Path of a file holding your Porkbun secret API key (sk1_...).

PORKBUN_OUTBOX_DIR.title: Folder for saved files
PORKBUN_OUTBOX_DIR.description: Where the tools that save a file (an SSL bundle, an invoice PDF, a DNS zone export, a new mailbox's password) write it. Without it those tools answer with a configuration error; every other tool works.

PORKBUN_TOOLSETS.title: Toolsets to load
PORKBUN_TOOLSETS.description: The toolsets whose tools the server loads, separated by commas, e.g. dns,forwards. Empty loads every toolset.

author: Forever Works
